newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran opens $700 mln aluminium plant.
newsitem.headline: Iran opens $700 mln aluminium plant.

text.p: Iran on Monday launched a new $700 million aluminium smelter near its Gulf port of Bandar Abbas, state-run Tehran radio said.
It said President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani inaugurated the first phase of the Al-Mahdi plant built for $300 million in hard cash in addition to 700 billion rials ($400 million).
The plant would have an initial annual production of 110,000 tonnes which would be later raised to 220,000, it added.
Officials said in February the first unit to be opened would have an annual output of 30,000 tonnes which would gradually be raised to 110,000 tonnes.
The first phase of the plant was originally due to open in early 1995, but was gradually postponed.
Some experts have blamed lack of funds for the two-year delay.

Iran already has an old smelter in the central city of Arak. Officials have said aluminium output reached 130,000 tonnes in the Iranian year that ended in March, up from 117,000 the previous year. ($1=1,750 rials at the rate used for state budget accounts)
